clips.title: The story
paras: Among Mathystra’s overgrown ruins in northern Darkshore, ancient night elven relics still hold traces of magic. The Twilight's Hammer cult has taken an interest in them.

Mathystra once stood on the Kalimdor coast as a city and bastion of elven civilization. Before the Great Sundering, it was a proud place. Now toppled columns and cracked stones lie half-swallowed by brush and sea mist, with restless spirits and lurking beasts among them. Relics from that age are scattered through the ruins. Ten thousand years of neglect have worn them, but traces of elven arcane craft remain, and they are dangerous in careless hands.
